correctness.rationale: For a outside F_q, t=N(x) and u=N(F_a(x)) obey u=t(t²+ct+d). Expanding F_a²(x)=x in the basis 1,a gives u+t+c=0 and tu=d+1; these imply u=-t, c=0 and t²=-d-1=a²-1. The converse is direct. Trace zero is impossible outside F_q in characteristic two; in odd characteristic a² is a nonsquare of F_q, so the norm equation has 0 or 2 nonzero roots, each with q+1 preimages. Character sums give (q-chi(-1))/2 favorable coefficients; Zieve classifies the relevant permutation coefficients. Standalone finite-field arithmetic checks 156 permutation parameters, 386 general parameters and 5549 direct power identities. No extrapolation from experiments was used.

value.rationale: A precise complete period-two invariant for the natural norm-lift binomial family of quadratic finite fields, including nonpermutation coefficients. It identifies a sharp 0-versus-(q+1) two-cycle dichotomy and exact base-field norm fibers, then classifies which of Zieve’s permutation coefficients realize either case and counts them uniformly over all field sizes. This answers a motivated cycle-structure question not determined by permutation status, not an arbitrary parameter slice or finite experimental table.
